# Toolisk

> Free, high-performance online tools for daily use — fast, private, and feature-rich. All computation happens client-side in the browser; no data is ever sent to a server.

Toolisk is a collection of finance calculators and developer utilities built for accuracy and speed. Tools are free, require no sign-up, and work entirely in your browser.

## Finance Calculators

- [EMI Calculator](https://toolisk.com/finance/emi-calculator): Calculate monthly loan repayments for home loans, car loans, and personal loans. Includes prepayment simulation, amortization schedule, and Reduce EMI vs Reduce Tenure comparison.
- [SIP Calculator](https://toolisk.com/finance/sip-calculator): Calculate Systematic Investment Plan returns with step-up SIP options. Visualise wealth accumulation and plan goal-based investments.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://toolisk.com/finance/compound-interest-calculator): Calculate compound interest for lump-sum investments across daily, monthly, and annual compounding frequencies.
- [FIRE Calculator](https://toolisk.com/finance/fire-calculator): Calculate the corpus needed for Financial Independence Retire Early. Supports Lean FIRE, Fat FIRE, Coast FIRE, and Barista FIRE strategies.
- [Income Tax Calculator](https://toolisk.com/finance/income-tax-calculator): Compare Old vs New tax regime for Indian taxpayers (FY 2025-26). Calculates tax liability, rebates, and deduction optimisation under Sections 80C, HRA, 80D, and more.
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://toolisk.com/finance/mortgage-calculator): Calculate home loan EMI and total housing cost including property tax, insurance, and maintenance.
- [Amortization Calculator](https://toolisk.com/finance/amortization-calculator): Generate month-by-month amortization schedules showing principal vs interest breakdown for any loan.
- [Buy vs Rent Calculator](https://toolisk.com/finance/buy-vs-rent-calculator): Compare buying vs renting with full cost analysis including opportunity cost, hidden ownership expenses, and long-term wealth accumulation.
- [US Paycheck Calculator](https://toolisk.com/finance/us-paycheck-calculator): Calculate federal & state tax, FICA, and pre-tax deductions for take-home pay across all 50 US states.
- [Credit Card Payoff Calculator](https://toolisk.com/finance/credit-card-payoff-calculator): Compare debt avalanche vs snowball vs minimum-only payoff strategies across multiple credit cards. Per-card schedule with interest saved.
- [401(k) Calculator](https://toolisk.com/finance/401k-calculator): Project US 401(k) retirement balance with employer match modeling, salary growth, 2026 contribution limits, and the 4% safe withdrawal rule.
- [Roth vs Traditional IRA Calculator](https://toolisk.com/finance/roth-vs-traditional-ira): True after-tax comparison including side-fund modeling for the Traditional tax savings. 2026 limits and RMD impact.
- [Auto Loan Calculator](https://toolisk.com/finance/auto-loan-calculator): Car loan payment with sales tax, trade-in, and dealer fees. Multi-currency (USD/EUR/GBP/AUD/CAD/INR) with side-by-side term comparison.
- [Student Loan Calculator](https://toolisk.com/finance/student-loan-calculator): Compare standard payoff, extra-payment, and refinance scenarios. Multi-currency with US federal-vs-private decision guide.
- [Investment Calculator](https://toolisk.com/finance/investment-calculator): Lump-sum + monthly contributions with inflation adjustment, annual step-up, and DCA vs lump-sum comparison. Multi-currency.
- [Rental Property ROI Calculator](https://toolisk.com/finance/rental-roi-calculator): Cap rate, cash flow, cash-on-cash return, DSCR, 1% rule, and GRM in one view. Multi-currency.
- [Net Worth Calculator](https://toolisk.com/finance/net-worth-calculator): Editable assets and liabilities with allocation pie chart and US Federal Reserve benchmark comparison by age.
- [US Inflation Calculator](https://toolisk.com/finance/inflation-calculator): 113 years of US Consumer Price Index data (1913–2026) for purchasing-power calculations.
- [Sales Tax / VAT / GST Calculator](https://toolisk.com/finance/sales-tax-vat-gst-calculator): Unified calculator for US sales tax, EU/UK VAT, Australian and Canadian GST/HST. Add or back out tax with regional rate presets.
- [Tip Calculator](https://toolisk.com/finance/tip-calculator): Calculate tips, split bills, and learn regional tipping etiquette across US/UK/EU/AU/CA/IN. Multi-currency with round-up option.

## Developer & Productivity Tools

- [URL Encoder / Decoder](https://toolisk.com/tools/url-encoder): Percent-encode URL components or decode them back.
- [JSON Viewer & Formatter](https://toolisk.com/tools/json-viewer): Format, validate, and explore JSON with collapsible tree view.
- [Word Counter](https://toolisk.com/tools/word-counter): Count words, characters, sentences, paragraphs and reading time.
- [Base64 Encoder / Decoder](https://toolisk.com/tools/base64): Encode/decode standard and URL-safe Base64.
- [Color Converter](https://toolisk.com/tools/color-converter): Convert between HEX, RGB, HSL, CMYK with WCAG contrast checks.
- [Hash Generator](https://toolisk.com/tools/hash-generator): Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 hashes locally.
- [Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://toolisk.com/tools/lorem-ipsum): Generate placeholder text for designs and mockups.
- [Case Converter](https://toolisk.com/tools/case-converter): Convert between camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case, PascalCase, etc.
- [Regex Tester](https://toolisk.com/tools/regex-tester): Test regular expressions live with match highlighting and capture groups.
- [Timestamp Converter](https://toolisk.com/tools/timestamp-converter): Convert Unix timestamps to/from human-readable dates with timezone support.
- [UUID Generator](https://toolisk.com/tools/uuid-generator): Generate UUID v4 and UUID v7 identifiers in bulk.
- [JWT Decoder](https://toolisk.com/tools/jwt-decoder): Decode JSON Web Tokens — header, payload, expiration check.
- [Password Generator](https://toolisk.com/tools/password-generator): Cryptographically secure random passwords or memorable passphrases.
- [HTML Entities Encoder/Decoder](https://toolisk.com/tools/html-entities): Encode/decode HTML entities — named, numeric, or hex.
- [SQL Formatter](https://toolisk.com/tools/sql-formatter): Format and beautify SQL queries with uppercase keywords and clause indentation.
- [URL Slug Generator](https://toolisk.com/tools/slug-generator): Convert any title into a clean URL slug. Bulk mode supported.
- [CSS Unit Converter](https://toolisk.com/tools/css-unit-converter): Convert between px, em, rem, pt, pc, %, vw, vh.
- [Cron Expression Parser](https://toolisk.com/tools/cron-parser): Parse cron expressions to plain English with next 10 runs preview.
- [Text Diff Checker](https://toolisk.com/tools/text-diff): Compare two pieces of text line by line with add/remove highlighting.
- [Markdown Preview](https://toolisk.com/tools/markdown-preview): Live markdown editor with side-by-side HTML rendering.
- [YAML / JSON Converter](https://toolisk.com/tools/yaml-json-converter): Convert YAML to JSON or JSON to YAML with live preview.
- [Number Base Converter](https://toolisk.com/tools/number-base-converter): Convert numbers between binary, octal, decimal, hex, and any base 2–36.
- [Image to Base64 Converter](https://toolisk.com/tools/image-base64): Convert images to Base64 data URLs or decode Base64 back to images.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://toolisk.com/tools/percentage-calculator): Find X% of Y, what percent X is of Y, percent change, and add/subtract percentages.
- [Age & Date Calculator](https://toolisk.com/tools/age-calculator): Calculate exact age, date differences, and deadline math.
- [Unit Converter](https://toolisk.com/tools/unit-converter): Convert 50+ units of length, weight, temperature, volume, area, and speed.
- [Color Palette Generator](https://toolisk.com/tools/color-palette): Generate tints, shades, complementary, analogous, and triadic color palettes.
- [Morse Code Converter](https://toolisk.com/tools/morse-code): Translate text to Morse code and back, with audio playback.
- [Text to Binary / Hex](https://toolisk.com/tools/text-binary): Encode text as binary, hex, decimal, or octal bytes — and decode back.
- [Caesar Cipher & ROT13](https://toolisk.com/tools/caesar-cipher): Encrypt and decrypt with Caesar cipher; brute-force all 26 shifts.
- [XML Formatter & Validator](https://toolisk.com/tools/xml-formatter): Format, minify, and validate XML in the browser.
- [HTTP Status Codes](https://toolisk.com/tools/http-status-codes): Searchable reference for all HTTP 1xx–5xx status codes.
- [Aspect Ratio Calculator](https://toolisk.com/tools/aspect-ratio): Calculate missing dimensions, detect ratios, and compute contain/cover fit.
- [Pomodoro Timer](https://toolisk.com/tools/pomodoro-timer): 25/5/15 Pomodoro productivity timer with session history.
- [JSON ↔ CSV Converter](https://toolisk.com/tools/json-csv): Convert JSON arrays to CSV or CSV to JSON with configurable delimiter.
- [Chmod Calculator](https://toolisk.com/tools/chmod-calculator): Generate Unix file permission commands from checkboxes or octal input.
